fields.Name: Diagnostics Session Started
fields.Description: A diagnostic recording session was started on the instance.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Session Stopped
fields.Description: A diagnostic recording session was stopped and its chunks were flushed.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Built
fields.Description: A .mjdiag diagnostic bundle was assembled, scrubbed, and verified.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Previewed
fields.Description: An operator inspected a diagnostic bundle's manifest, scrubbing summary, and findings.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Downloaded
fields.Description: A diagnostic bundle archive was downloaded via a single-use signed capability token.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Sent
fields.Description: An encrypted diagnostic bundle was transmitted to an external collector or storage account.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Send Failed
fields.Description: An attempt to transmit an encrypted diagnostic bundle externally failed.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Bundle Received
fields.Description: An external .mjdiag.enc bundle was ingested, cryptographically verified, structurally validated, and malware-checked by the MJAPI intake endpoint.

fields.Name: Diagnostics Sharing Settings Changed
fields.Description: Instance configuration settings governing diagnostic capture, literal scrubbing, or external transmission were modified.
